credit_note.title: Issue credit note
credit_note.hint_on_debit_note: A credit note correcting debit note {{no}} ({{total}}) in full. An issued note cannot be edited or deleted; its remedy is an opposite note. It is sent to ZATCA as a 381 document linked to it.
credit_note.hint_on_invoice: A credit note for the full value of invoice {{no}} ({{total}}). It reverses the invoice's effect in the books without changing the original invoice, and is sent to ZATCA as a 381 document linked to it.
credit_note.reason_placeholder: Example: goods returned / service cancelled / amount corrected

debit_note.title: Issue debit note
debit_note.hint_on_credit_note: A debit note correcting credit note {{no}} ({{total}}). It restores any excess to the customer's balance and cannot exceed the note's value. An issued note cannot be edited or deleted. It is sent to ZATCA as a 383 document linked to it.
debit_note.hint_on_invoice: Additional amounts on invoice {{no}}: recorded against the customer as new receivables, and sent to ZATCA as a 383 document linked to it. The original invoice is not changed.
debit_note.reason_placeholder: Example: unbilled shipping costs / price difference

page.err_credit_note: Could not issue the credit note
page.err_debit_note: Could not issue the debit note
page.err_download_cleared: Could not download the cleared invoice
page.credit_override_confirm: Exceed and issue — recorded under your name
page.replacement_title: Issue a replacement for the rejected invoice
page.replacement_body: Invoice {{no}} is closed as it is (its counter and hash stay untouched), and a new document with a new number and the same lines is issued in its place. Its entry is reversed and its goods return to the shelf and are then deducted for the replacement; anything collected on it moves to the replacement, and the move is recorded under your name. {{tail}}
page.replacement_standard: Standard invoice: the replacement carries today's date.
page.replacement_simplified: Simplified invoice: the replacement keeps the original transaction date and is not reissued to the customer.
page.submit_body: Send invoice {{no}} for clearance? An invoice cannot be withdrawn once cleared.
